author: Larry K. Morphew
book_description: In the hot, dry summer of 1938, Henry Cooper and his two brothers spent as much time as they could swimming in the cool water of Saline Creek at Willow Bend. But, on this particular Tuesday, everything changed after Sheriff Enoch Cobb required their help in the retrieving a dead body. The truth of how the old man died would be revealed as Henry and his brother Levi overhear a conversation while hiding in the roots of a blown over tree. Danger lurks as the brothers help six sisters escape from the clutches of a captive home and an evil father.Show more
